hooks.name: Task Completion Changelog
hooks.description: Appends a timestamped entry to CHANGELOG.md whenever a spec task is marked complete

action.command: node -e \"const d=new Date().toISOString();const stdin=require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8');let info='unknown task';try{const j=JSON.parse(stdin);info=j.taskDescription||j.task_description||JSON.stringify(j);}catch(e){}const line=d+' COMPLETED: '+info+'\n';require('fs').appendFileSync('CHANGELOG.md',line);\"
